# Engineering Lab article review template

- Slug:
- Title:
- Summary:
- Category and filter topics:
- Actual technologies used:
- Status: Implemented / Troubleshooting case study / In progress / Learning / research / Planned
- Resolved? What observation supports that conclusion?
- Source/evidence reviewed privately:
- Public evidence links (omit if unavailable):
- Publication/update dates (leave empty until actual publication/edit):
- Published build flag: false until copy is reviewable
- Featured: false

## Problem or motivation

What was observed? Why did the work matter in this personal environment?

## Context and design

Describe only established components. A simplified conceptual diagram may omit sensitive details; label it explicitly.

## Implementation or investigation

Explain decisions, diagnostic evidence and alternatives considered. Label sample commands as illustrative; include no invented output.

## Tradeoffs and failure considerations

What constraints or operational risks apply? What has not been tested?

## Outcome and evidence boundary

What changed, and what observation supports that? Do not imply current uptime, benchmark results or production impact without evidence.

## Lessons learned

One specific, reusable engineering lesson.

## Next steps

Clearly proposed work, not accomplishments.

## Owner publication review

- [ ] Facts and status confirmed
- [ ] Personal/employer boundary clear
- [ ] Addresses, identifiers and secrets removed
- [ ] Media and links real and approved
- [ ] Dates represent actual publication/edits
- [ ] Responsive layout, keyboard behavior and export checks passed
- [ ] Separate push/deployment approval obtained
